title: F2E Completion Event v1
description: Technical conclusion event published to the completion queue when a job reaches a terminal state. Consumers must not treat arrival of this event as a barrier between record envelopes in the record queue.

schemaVersion.description: Schema version identifier. Consumers must check this and reject unknown versions.

eventId.description: Deterministic SHA-256 hex identifier derived from jobId and completion version. Duplicate deliveries share the same eventId.

jobId.description: Stable job identifier (equals fileId for normal executions).

prefixId.description: Configuration prefix that governed this job. Optional for environments without prefix isolation.

source.description: Immutable S3 coordinates used during processing.

config.description: Minimum provenance to correlate with the SSM configuration version used.

configId.description: SHA-256 hash of the SSM configuration content (configHash from ConfigurationSnapshot).

parameterName.description: SSM parameter name that supplied the configuration.

result.description: Qualifies a COMPLETED job. Absent for FAILED and REJECTED.

counts.description: Aggregated record counters. When countsComplete is true: recordsRead = recordsPublished + recordsRejected + recordsIgnored.

countsComplete.description: False when the job failed partway and a proven final total cannot be guaranteed.

rejectionReason.description: Primary rejection reason for REJECTED jobs. Selected from the bounded catalog (INVALID_CONFIG, UNSUPPORTED_TYPE, EMPTY_FILE, INVALID_UTF8, etc.).
